description: §15.11.4 (S459 round 6, F4) — a literal (string `"x"`, number `${5}`) passed to a function-typed prop is E-TYPE-031, once per call site. Before round 6 it emitted `"x"()` with no diagnostic.
rationale: §15.11.4: "The compiler SHALL verify at the call site that the value provided for a function-typed prop is assignable to the declared function signature. A type mismatch SHALL be E-TYPE-031."
